details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:10, 173 and 255 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: SERENA_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_SEC is defined but both TOML heredocs hardcode startup_timeout_sec = 30, so changing the shell variable has no effect.
  WHY: The literal 30 is written regardless of the variable, and qwen notes this also leaves the probe-timeout expectation decoupled from the variable.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:124-196 (clear), 207-275 (write) | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: clear_serena_codex_config and write_serena_codex_config duplicate nearly identical embedded Python for stripping, validating, and writing the TOML.
  WHY: Any fix to the shared parsing or block-stripping logic has to be applied in two places, so the paths can drift.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:34-51 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: append_github_path avoids duplicates in PATH but unconditionally appends the same directory to GITHUB_PATH.
  WHY: Repeated calls can add duplicate path entries for later workflow steps.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:129-184 (clear_serena_codex_config heredoc), 213-269 (write_serena_codex_config heredoc) | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: Both embedded Python blocks skip TOML validation whenever tomllib is unavailable.
  WHY: On Python < 3.11, malformed config text can be written to ~/.codex/config.toml without any parse check.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:129-184 (clear_serena_codex_config heredoc), 213-269 (write_serena_codex_config heredoc) | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The inline tomllib.loads(rendered) call is not protected, so malformed TOML aborts the setup script under set -euo pipefail.
  WHY: A bad rendered config causes the heredoc interpreter to exit non-zero and stops Serena bootstrap instead of failing soft.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:272-281 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: render_serena_project copies serena_project.yml.j2 verbatim instead of rendering it.
  WHY: If template variables are added later, they would be written literally into .serena/project.yml.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:100-112 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: binary_matches_pin only checks the first line of --version output.
  WHY: A multi-line version banner with the version on a later line would be misclassified as unpinned and trigger unnecessary reinstalls.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:42-46 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The template enables python, python_jedi, and python_ty together for the same .py files.
  WHY: Multiple Python backends can compete over the same sources depending on Serena's backend selection behavior.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:56-66 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: _sanitize_log_value only normalizes whitespace and leaves = unchanged.
  WHY: A value containing = can break the key=value parsing contract of SERENA_PROBE and SERENA_QUERY log lines.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:178 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: validate_initialize_response accepts a response with result plus "error": null.
  WHY: It checks message.get("error") is not None, so a buggy JSON-RPC response that carries an error key with null is incorrectly accepted.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:229-230 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: probe_initialize uses assert to verify proc.stdin and proc.stdout.
  WHY: Those checks disappear under python -O, which removes the guard and can turn later failures into less-diagnostic AttributeError crashes.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:155-156 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: probe_initialize uses assert to verify proc.stdin and proc.stdout.
  WHY: Those checks disappear under python -O, which removes the guard and can turn later failures into less-diagnostic AttributeError crashes.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:248-254 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The BrokenPipeError handler raises ProbeError without calling _cleanup_process(proc).
  WHY: Server stderr diagnostics are lost because the subprocess is not cleaned up and its stderr is not drained.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:192-195 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The BrokenPipeError handler raises ProbeError without calling _cleanup_process(proc).
  WHY: Server stderr diagnostics are lost because the subprocess is not cleaned up and its stderr is not drained.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:196-197 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: _cleanup_process reads stderr unconditionally after process termination.
  WHY: The blocking read is a robustness gap if the pipe does not close cleanly.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:139 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: proc.stderr.read() is called with no timeout after proc.kill().
  WHY: That cleanup path can block indefinitely if stderr does not reach EOF promptly.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:248-252 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: probe_initialize returns after validate_initialize_response without joining the reader thread.
  WHY: The daemon reader can remain blocked on stdout until parent process exit.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:273-275 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: probe_initialize returns after validate_initialize_response without joining the reader thread.
  WHY: The daemon reader can remain blocked on stdout until parent process exit.
- scripts/serena_stats_emit.py:114-122 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: emit_rollups interpolates the parsed tool name directly into SERENA_QUERY without sanitizing it.
  WHY: A tool name containing spaces or = would break the downstream key=value log format.
- scripts/serena_stats_emit.py:21 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: SERENA_CALL_RE only matches single-segment Serena tool names in plaintext logs.
  WHY: Namespaced tool calls with dots would be parsed as the prefix only, undercounting telemetry.
- scripts/serena_stats_emit.py:50-70 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: SERENA_CALL_RE only matches single-segment Serena tool names in plaintext logs.
  WHY: Namespaced tool calls with dots would be parsed as the prefix only, undercounting telemetry.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:10, 173 and 255 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: SERENA_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_SEC is defined but never referenced, while both TOML-writing heredocs hardcode startup_timeout_sec = 30.
  WHY: Changing the shell variable has no effect on the rendered config, so future maintainers will be misled.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:248-253 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The BrokenPipeError handler raises ProbeError without calling _cleanup_process(proc).
  WHY: The subprocess is left unterminated and its stderr diagnostics are lost.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:61-66 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: _sanitize_log_value does not escape = characters.
  WHY: Values containing = can break the key=value format used by SERENA_PROBE log lines.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:129-184 (clear_serena_codex_config heredoc), 213-269 (write_serena_codex_config heredoc) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Both embedded Python blocks skip TOML validation when tomllib is unavailable.
  WHY: On Python versions before 3.11, malformed TOML can be written to ~/.codex/config.toml without any parse check.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:229-230 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: probe_initialize uses assert statements to verify proc.stdin and proc.stdout are not None.
  WHY: Under python -O, those checks are removed and any future invariant break would surface as a less-diagnostic AttributeError.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:196-197 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: _cleanup_process reads stderr unconditionally after process termination.
  WHY: The blocking read is a theoretical robustness gap if the pipe does not close cleanly.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:124-196 (clear), 207-275 (write) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: clear_serena_codex_config and write_serena_codex_config duplicate nearly identical embedded Python heredocs.
  WHY: Any change to block stripping or TOML validation has to be made in two places, risking divergence.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:37-51 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: append_github_path writes the directory to GITHUB_PATH on every call even when PATH already contains it.
  WHY: Repeated invocations create duplicate entries in downstream workflow steps.
- scripts/serena_stats_emit.py:114-122 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: emit_rollups writes the tool name from parsed JSON directly into SERENA_QUERY.
  WHY: A future data-derived tool value containing special characters would break downstream key=value parsing.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:100-112 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: binary_matches_pin only inspects the first line of --version output.
  WHY: If the version appears later in a multi-line banner, the binary is misclassified as unpinned.
- scripts/serena_stats_emit.py:21 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: SERENA_CALL_RE does not match dotted Serena tool names in plaintext logs.
  WHY: Namespaced tool names like serena.tools.find would be truncated and undercounted.
- scripts/templates/serena_project.yml.j2:42-44 | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The template enables python, python_jedi, and python_ty simultaneously.
  WHY: Multiple Python backends may compete over the same source files depending on Serena's resolution logic.
